claims.text: Every villa and suite has a private pool and spacious outdoor living areas.

findings.quote: Every accommodation features a private pool and spacious outdoor living areas, offering exceptional privacy and comfort.
findings.note: States that every accommodation has a private pool and spacious outdoor living areas.

findings.quote: Each one of our villas and suites features a private pool and spacious outdoor areas where you can enjoy absolute privacy and comfort.
findings.note: Corroborates the claim for all villas and suites.

claims.text: The resort blends local Mexican traditions and hospitality with Asian culture.

findings.quote: Here, in the heart of Mexico’s Riviera Maya, local traditions and hospitality meet Asian culture and wisdom in a true Sanctuary for the Senses.
findings.note: Local (Mexican) traditions and hospitality are blended with Asian culture.

claims.text: The resort has a white-sand beachfront that guests can use for swimming and snorkeling.

findings.quote: Step onto soft, powdery sands and enjoy exclusive access to our serene beachfront—perfect for swimming, snorkeling, or simply soaking up the sun with a cocktail in hand.
findings.note: Beachfront is described as suitable for swimming and snorkeling, under the heading 'Private White-Sand Beach & Pools'.

findings.quote: each with a private heated plunge pool and direct access to the resort’s white-sand beach
findings.note: Confirms the resort's beach is white-sand.

claims.text: In the Family Residences, a rooftop solarium has a pool overlooking the golf course.

findings.quote: The rooftop solarium, with its pool overlooking the stunning golf course, provides a serene escape surrounded by nature.
findings.note: Appears in the descriptions of both the Two- and Three-Bedroom Family Residences.

claims.text: The Serenity Pool Villa with Living Room has Talavera-glazed earthenware sinks.

findings.quote: natural hues, complemented with splashes of color and Talavera-glazed earthenware sinks, will remind you of your Caribbean surroundings
findings.note: Serenity Pool Villa with Living Room page mentions Talavera-glazed earthenware sinks.

claims.text: The spa's pavilions and suites reflect local Mexican heritage.

findings.quote: Thoughtfully designed pavilions and suites reflect local Mexican heritage while embracing the beauty of the Riviera Maya.
findings.note: Official spa page states this directly.

findings.quote: the Banyan Tree Spa offers wellness therapies within opulent treatment pavilions, each adorned with distinct Balinese interior design
findings.note: The editorial review describes the pavilions' design as Balinese rather than Mexican.

claims.text: The spa's Rainforest is a hydrothermal experience inspired by Asian and European healing traditions.

findings.quote: The Rainforest is a complete hydrothermal experience inspired by the healing traditions of Asia and Europe.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: Spa therapists are trained at the Banyan Tree Spa & Wellbeing Academy in Phuket.

findings.quote: Our therapists are trained at the Banyan Tree Spa & Wellbeing Academy in Phuket
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: Saffron is the resort's signature Thai restaurant.

findings.quote: Key resort features include signature Thai dining at Saffron and holistic treatments at the Banyan Tree Spa.
findings.note: Saffron is the resort's signature Thai dining venue.

findings.quote: Saffron is the resort’s mainstay eatery for classic Thai dishes
findings.note: Corroborates Saffron as the main Thai restaurant.

claims.text: Complimentary bicycles let guests ride through jungle trails, along canals and to the beach.

findings.quote: Ride through lush jungle trails, along scenic canals, and toward the beach or your next dining spot
findings.note: Appears under the 'Complimentary Bicycles' section.

claims.text: Mayakoba's three-mile nature trail winds through mangroves and lagoons, with bird-watching towers.

findings.quote: Mayakoba’s three-mile nature trail is ideal for walking, jogging, or cycling through lush tropical landscapes. The path winds through mangroves and lagoons, with rest areas and bird-watching towers offering peaceful spots.
findings.note: Covers the three-mile length, the mangroves and lagoons, and the bird-watching towers.

claims.text: The Kid's Club is located at Sands Beach Club.

findings.quote: The Kid’s Club, located at our Sands Beach Club, is the most fun-filled corner of Banyan Tree Mayakoba.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

findings.quote: The resort offers a program called the Rangers Club, a space located in the Sands Beach Club
findings.note: Corroborates the Sands Beach Club location.

claims.text: Banyan Tree Mayakoba is an all-private-pool villa resort set within the protected mangroves and freshwater lagoons of Mayakoba, with direct access to the Caribbean coast.

findings.quote: Banyan Tree Mayakoba is an all-private-pool villa resort set within the protected mangroves and freshwater lagoons of Mayakoba, offering direct access to the Caribbean coast.
findings.note: Matches the claim verbatim.

claims.text: The Lagoon & Sunset Rooftop Pool Villa is a two-storey over-the-water villa steps from the white-sand beach.

findings.quote: Find tranquility in this stunning two-storey, over-the-water villa, just steps from the white-sand beach.
findings.note: Description of the Lagoon & Sunset Rooftop Pool Villa.

claims.text: The spa offers a Temazcal ritual, an ancient Mesoamerican ceremony led by a shaman inside a sacred dome with volcanic stones and healing herbs.

findings.quote: Reconnect with Mother Earth through the ancient Mesoamerican ritual of Temazcal. Led by a shaman inside a sacred dome, volcanic stones and healing herbs guide this deeply purifying journey
findings.note: Ixmucané appears on the spa page.

claims.text: A complimentary ecotour through the canals offers sightings of wildlife such as birds, turtles and crocodiles.

findings.quote: Discover Mayakoba’s beauty on a complimentary ecotour through scenic canals. Glide past lush landscapes, while spotting local wildlife like birds, turtles, and crocodiles.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: Mayakoba has a cenote called Burrodromo that is exclusive to Mayakoba guests.

findings.quote: Here in Mayakoba, we have a cenote called Burródromo, exclusive for Mayakoba guests.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: At night, Saffron, Cello, Tomahawk and Sands Beach Club recommend elegant-casual attire, and beach shorts and flip-flops are not permitted.

findings.quote: At night: Saffron, Cello, Tomahawk Open Fire Latin Grill, Sands Beach Club: Elegant-casual attire is recommended. Beach shorts and flip-flops are not permitted.
findings.note: Matches the dress code claim.

claims.text: The resort is a 20-minute drive from downtown Playa del Carmen.

findings.quote: We are a 20-minute drive from downtown Playa del Carmen
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the resort's ultra-luxury positioning.
